Evaluation Criteria
All eligible submissions will be evaluated based on the following criteria:
Authenticity: Whether the content reflects genuine product usage and real-world experiences.
Depth of Product Experience: Whether the review provides detailed insights into specific product features and practical use cases.
Value of Feedback: Whether the suggestions are clear, constructive, and actionable.
Originality & Creativity: Whether the content is original and presents product experiences in an engaging way.
Community Engagement & Reach: The post's visibility, engagement, and overall social reach.
Priority will be given to authentic, insightful, and high-quality original content. Social engagement and reach will be considered as supporting factors rather than the sole criteria.
Valuable product feedback may also be collected and shared with the Bitget product team to support future product improvements.
Campaign Rules & Terms
The campaign is open to all Bitget users. Participants must provide a valid Bitget UID and complete the required posting and submission steps.
All submissions must relate to the designated product theme of the corresponding phase and be based on genuine product experiences.

Participants must publish their content within the corresponding campaign period and submit a valid X post link and required information through the designated form.
Plagiarism, copied content, fabricated feedback, artificial engagement, or other fraudulent activities are strictly prohibited and may result in disqualification.
Duplicate submissions of the same content will only be counted once. Posts must remain publicly accessible during the evaluation period for verification.
Bitget reserves the right to modify and interpret the campaign rules to the extent permitted by applicable laws.
